issues.description: Field 'animals' of class Farm: the problem statement UML and instructions indicate 'animals' is a private aggregation attribute with public getter/setter (UML: '- animals: List<Animal>'). In the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) the field is declared public: 'public List<Animal> animals;'. This visibility difference contradicts the stated encapsulation in the exercise and may confuse students about whether they should access the list directly or via the provided getAnimals()/setAnimals() methods.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Farm 'animals' field private to match the UML and problem instructions. In src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java change the declaration 'public List<Animal> animals;' to 'private List<Animal> animals;'. Keep the existing public getAnimals() and setAnimals(List<Animal>) methods so students must use the accessor methods. Alternatively, update the problem statement to explicitly state that the field may be public if you intend to allow direct access (less preferred pedagogically).
